The silhouette is identical to the product line: rounded body, short neck, flat tail, small beak, two flat webbed feet, plain oval black pupil with NO decorative glint. No props, no ornament — only black mass and white field. The composition reads as a printed avant-garde monograph cover, brutalist in restraint, austere and institutional. Aspect ratio 16:9, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp on the duck.
